task: StarJournal skill VFX atlas layer production

prompts.sword: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX texture atlas for a premium 2.5D dark fantasy action RPG. Create ONE square 1536x1536 transparent PNG atlas, exactly 3 equal columns by 3 equal rows. Each invisible 512x512 cell contains ONE independent hand-painted magical effect layer, isolated and centered. This is an atlas of nine DIFFERENT components, not a sequential animation. Every component and all its glow stay inside the central 70% of its cell, with generous fully transparent gutters of at least 15% on all four sides. No effect crosses a grid boundary. True RGBA transparency, delicate translucent emission edges. High-end painterly realistic energy, fine luminous filaments, crisp sculpted light, smoky detail without opaque backdrop, visually elegant readable silhouettes. No people, no weapons held by people, no environments, no UI, no labels, no lettering, no borders, no checkerboard, no black rectangle. Row-major layout exactly as specified. Use an orthographic front view. Rings face the viewer as perfect circles so they can be flattened to the ground by the engine. Directional components point RIGHT. Make the layers visually rich enough to look beautiful in motion at 100-250 pixels. Keep the overall atlas clean and separated. Theme: holy knight and blood-warrior energy; silver-white razor light, antique gold, small controlled crimson battle embers. Cell 0 top left: a compact right-facing golden-white lance of light with tapered trail. Cell 1 top middle: a sweeping crescent slash, silver-white cutting edge and flowing gold inner filaments, opens right. Cell 2 top right: explosive radial gold-white impact crown with flying sparks. Cell 3 middle left: ornate circular golden ground rune ring, clear empty center, no readable writing. Cell 4 middle center: upright golden heraldic shield made of light, clean pointed silhouette, luminous layered edges. Cell 5 middle right: a fan of small crimson and gold metal-like light shards. Cell 6 bottom left: narrow upward erupting crimson-gold energy plume with bright base. Cell 7 bottom middle: a circular silver-gold battle vortex with distinct curling light ribbons and transparent center. Cell 8 bottom right: one small concentrated white-gold star-shaped spark core, refined rays, occupying only the central 30% of its cell.

alphaCorrectionPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the provided transparent 3x3 game VFX texture atlas. Change ONLY the defective background alpha. The nine beautifully painted effect components MUST retain exactly their existing designs, colors, scale, positions, and nine-cell row-major layout. The current image has an unwanted broad whitish-gray atmospheric fog covering the empty space of the sheet, especially the top two rows. REMOVE THAT BACKGROUND FOG COMPLETELY, yielding literal alpha=0 transparent empty space between all nine components and along every outer edge. Do not leave a white, gray, black, checkerboard, or translucent rectangle. Do not add shadows, scenery, or framing. Preserve localized colored emission/glow and colored smoke that is directly attached to each magical object, with soft antialiased transparent edges. Everything away from the distinct nine isolated silhouettes should be fully transparent. Each effect stays inside its existing equal-sized cell, with clean transparent gutters so each can be cropped independently with no background rectangle. Keep the central open spaces of rings/vortices transparent. Preserve the same square canvas and exact 3x3 geometry. This is a technical background correction, not a redesign.

summonPrompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent summoned-creature sprite for a premium 2.5D dark fantasy action RPG. One majestic spectral hunting hawk in flight, facing RIGHT in clear three-quarter side profile, beak and eyes on the right, tail trailing left, both powerful wings completely visible and unclipped. Body formed from translucent emerald-teal spirit light with exquisite fine gold-white feather filaments and bright sculpted feather tips. Anatomically readable as a hawk, not an abstract badge, not a shield, not a logo. Dynamic elegant airborne pose; high-end hand-painted game illustration, fine light textures and superb silhouette at small size. Full creature centered within square canvas, occupies at most 68% of width and height, at least 16% transparent empty margin on EVERY edge. Scene/backdrop: literal alpha=0 true transparent background. The empty canvas must have NO fog, NO gray/white/black backdrop, NO clouds, NO environment, NO floor, NO ground shadow, NO platform, NO text, NO border, NO checkerboard. Restrict luminous light and colored mist strictly to the creature itself and a very narrow soft antialiased edge; no broad atmospheric glow across empty space. Only one bird, no other objects. Transparent cutout for direct source-over compositing into a dark game battlefield.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent summoned-fire-elemental sprite for a premium 2.5D dark fantasy action RPG. One elegant nonhuman fire spirit, floating and facing RIGHT in clear three-quarter side profile. Its body is made entirely of sculpted orange-gold magical flames around a brilliant white-gold ember core, with a distinguishable spirit head and two graceful flame arms, a tapering whirling flame tail rather than legs. Expressive powerful fiery silhouette, no clothes, no armor, no weapon, no pedestal; a magical elemental creature, not a human portrait and not a fireball. Rich layered hand-painted flame filaments, warm vermilion edges, subtle golden motes contained close to body, high-end 2.5D fantasy game asset, readable at small size. Whole creature centered within square canvas, occupies at most 68% of width and height, at least 16% fully transparent empty margin on EVERY side. Scene/backdrop: literal alpha=0 true transparent background. NO smoke backdrop, NO white/gray/black rectangle, NO environment, NO ground, NO shadow, NO base, NO text, NO border, NO checkerboard. Luminous color and localized fire wisps only within and immediately alongside creature silhouette. Absolutely no broad atmospheric haze in the empty canvas. Only one isolated summoned spirit, direct source-over cutout for a dark game battlefield.
